title: Valid Authority Artifact vs Current Authority-Chain Continuity
version_note: V120 is used because V119 already names the Harmonic evidence-discovery surface; this successor examination does not overwrite that lineage.
architectural_boundary: Frozen external trust anchor R0 -> current empowerment relation -> unchanged B-to-C delegation -> unchanged C authority instrument -> Specialty Pack authority-chain admission -> constituted domain state -> Harmonic determination
frozen_proposition: A Specialty Pack must distinguish the continued validity of an intermediate authority artifact from the continued standing of the authority path that empowers it.
distinction: Valid authority artifact is not equivalent to currently intact authority chain.
root_anchor_rule: R0 is prospectively frozen as the constituted external trust anchor for this examination and is outside the falsifier.
anti_circularity_rule: No intermediate authority artifact may establish continuity of the authority path merely by remaining current, signed, attributable or internally valid.

pair.case_a: R0 currently empowers B for the proposition; the unchanged B-to-C delegation therefore reaches C, and C's unchanged current, fresh, valid authority instrument can govern.
pair.case_b: C's instrument (including freshness) and the B-to-C delegation remain byte-equivalent and valid, but R0 no longer empowers B for the proposition and has transferred that competence to B2; no B2-to-C delegation is supplied.

pass: The Pack stops allowing C's unchanged authority instrument to constitute governing state in Case B because the current empowerment path from R0 no longer reaches C.
fail: The Pack continues treating C as governing in Case B merely because C's instrument or the B-to-C delegation remains current, signed, attributable, fresh, historically legitimate or internally valid.
unresolved: The architecture cannot represent the current empowerment path independently from the validity of the artifacts inside it, or the frozen pair cannot execute without changing another substantive dimension.
falsifier: Can an intermediate authority artifact remain individually valid while the current authority chain behind it is broken — and does the Pack notice?
secondary_harmonic_witness: Harmonic exact replay is downstream witness evidence only. RED TEAM 004 passes or fails first at the Specialty Pack authority-chain admission boundary; Harmonic cannot rescue an incorrect Pack constitution.
claim_ceiling: A future PASS is bounded to the frozen synthetic R0 anchor, the represented R0-to-B empowerment relation, the unchanged B-to-C delegation, the unchanged C authority instrument, and the executable Pack reference. It does not establish the external truth or legitimacy of R0, universal recursive authority closure, or downstream physical enforcement.
